courses.title: Graphic Design with Canva
courses.shortDescription: Live online training in graphic design with canva for women who want practical, home-friendly skills.
courses.description: LIVE ONLINE TRAINING – NOT A RECORDED COURSE. This one-month Zoom programme focuses on visual design, video editing and creative content creation tools. You will attend four live classes each week, complete practical exercises and take part in question-and-answer sessions with the instructor. Helpful for creating social posts, logos, reels and simple video content for clients or personal projects. Intakes are planned for the 1st of every month. Exact class days and timings are shared with registered participants after enrolment. Classes are interactive; this is not a pre-recorded video course.
courses.schedule: Four live classes per week. Exact class days and timings will be shared with registered participants.
learningOutcomes: Create clean social media graphics
Apply basic layout and colour principles
Export files in the correct formats
Build a small sample design portfolio
requirements: Smartphone or computer with a stable internet connection
Willingness to attend scheduled live Zoom sessions
Ability to install or access design apps (free plans where possible)
